I compared Ravi Ortiz's active medication list (updated 2024-05-02) with the discharge summary for encounter enc_00418 (discharged 2024-04-19). There is a dose discrepancy for levothyroxine 10 mg vs 50 mg: the medication list shows 10 mg once daily, while the discharge summary lists 50 mg once daily as 'continued.' The units are also unusual for levothyroxine, so this may be a transcription or unit error, and given his last TSH of 6.8 mIU/L it needs prescriber review before either value is used. There is also a date discrepancy for lisinopril 10 mg: the medication list gives a start date of 2024-04-22, but the discharge summary marks it as new starting 2024-04-19. Metoprolol succinate 25 mg and atorvastatin 40 mg match in both sources. I have not chosen either source for levothyroxine or lisinopril; both items are flagged as unresolved and should go to the prescriber or pharmacist.
